summary: Published a navigable Sourcey-generated API reference for the maintained open-source library Ory Kratos (Apache-2.0), built from its pinned v26.2.0 OpenAPI specification (56 operations, 155 schemas) and validated with a recomputable runx receipt (runx-cli 0.9.1; runx verify reports valid).
observations: runx --version = runx-cli 0.9.1 (satisfies the required 0.6.13 or newer).
runx skill validation run sealed receipt sha256:fffd1c20c8ad34dd08649128c0875887f8daf931d382a4ae8d8de266c255ecd9; runx verify reports valid: true.
Target: maintained OSS library Ory Kratos, pinned tag v26.2.0 at commit 9d7085948039ffb8960160d4979f71527b5cf4d5, license Apache-2.0.
OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec spec/api.json (sha256 f258cd01) exposes 56 documented operations across 48 paths.
155 component schemas are documented in the generated reference.
Documentation generated with the Sourcey (npm) static-site generator from the pinned spec.
Live site https://milacl007.github.io/sourcey-docs/ returns HTTP 200 and serves a navigable, searchable API reference.
Reproduce: npx sourcey build skill/api.json ; runx skill ./skill -R ./receipts ; runx verify --receipt-dir ./receipts.
